iperf.clientStarted: iperf3 test started. Poll /api/iperf/client/status for results.

interfaceDown.summary: Interface {{interface}} on {{device}} went down while it was administratively up.
interfaceDown.summaryWithBgp: Interface {{interface}} on {{device}} went down while it was administratively up. BGP sessions on {{device}} that dropped after it: {{peers}}.

evidence.operStatus: ifOperStatus went from up to {{status}} on ifIndex {{ifIndex}} at {{time}}.
evidence.counterPeak: {{counter}} on {{interface}} peaked at {{rate}} per second in the {{minutes}} minutes before it went down.
evidence.countersClean: {{interface}} counted no errors or discards in the {{minutes}} minutes before it went down (rated polls: {{polls}}).
evidence.bgpPeer: BGP peer {{peer}} (AS{{as}}) left Established {{seconds}} s later.

next.down: Check the physical link on {{interface}}: the cable, the optic and the far-end port, then whether the far-end device is up.
next.downAfterErrors: {{interface}} was counting errors before it went down, so the link is failing physically. Replace or reseat the cable and the optic on {{interface}}, then read the error counters of the far-end port.
next.lowerLayerDown: {{interface}} is waiting on the layer beneath it. Check the port, bundle or tunnel it runs over on {{device}}.
next.notPresent: Part of {{interface}} is missing. Check that its module or transceiver is seated and recognised on {{device}}.
next.testing: {{interface}} is in test mode. Find the test running on {{device}} and end it.
next.dormant: {{interface}} is waiting for an external event, such as a standby or dial-on-demand link. Confirm on {{device}} that this is expected.
next.unknown: {{device}} did not report why {{interface}} is down. Log in to {{device}} and read the interface status.

bgpFlap.summary: The BGP session to {{peer}} (AS{{as}}) on {{device}} left Established, with no interface-down alert on {{device}} in the {{minutes}} minutes before it.

evidence.state: bgpPeerState went from established to {{state}} at {{time}}.

next.idle: The session was reset. Read the BGP notification in the log on {{device}}: a hold timer expiry, a prefix limit or a configuration change.
next.connect: {{device}} cannot complete a TCP connection to {{peer}}. Check reachability to {{peer}} and whether TCP port 179 is filtered between them.
next.active: {{device}} cannot complete a TCP connection to {{peer}}. Check reachability to {{peer}} and whether TCP port 179 is filtered between them.
next.openSent: TCP connects, but the BGP OPEN exchange with {{peer}} fails. Compare the AS number, hold time and authentication on both sides.
next.openConfirm: TCP connects, but the BGP OPEN exchange with {{peer}} fails. Compare the AS number, hold time and authentication on both sides.
next.unknown: Log in to {{device}} and read the state of the BGP session to {{peer}}.

storage.next: Find what grew on {{filesystem}}, such as logs, core dumps or captures, then clear it or extend the filesystem.
